zh.title: 任务没搬走，账本为什么已经写着‘进入审查’？
zh.summary: 一次受控提交报错后，任务仍在执行目录，文件头却已标记为待审。我们对照重试与丢失回执，研究多 Agent 系统如何证明状态转换真正完成。

en.title: The task never moved. Why does its record say it entered review?
en.summary: A controlled submission failed while the task stayed in the active directory, yet its metadata already said review. We compared retry and lost-receipt paths to ask how an agent team proves a transition completed.
